sequence.counter_next_note: The next number is last number + increment, an estimate only: concurrent requests may take it first. A counter is never edited or reset by hand.

sequence.template_legend: Placeholders: %(year)s or {YYYY}, %(y)s or {YY}, %(month)s or {MM}, %(day)s or {DD}, %(doy)s (day of year 001–366), %(woy)s (week 00–53, weeks start on Monday), %(weekday)s (Sunday = 0), %(h24)s, %(h12)s, %(min)s, %(sec)s, %(isoyear)s, %(isoy)s, %(isoweek)s, and %(period)s or {PERIOD}. Prefix a date variable with range_ for the start of the reset period (not with reset Never) or with current_ for the time the request was accepted. %% writes a percent sign; a doubled brace writes a brace. Anything else, such as {WH}, is refused.
settings_desc.density: How tightly controls, rows and fields are packed. Compact fits more on the screen without changing the text size.
settings_desc.language: The language the interface is shown in. Only languages the application ships translations for can be selected.

settings_desc.system_timezone: The timezone this organization's business day runs on. Shared reports are stamped with this zone.
settings_desc.theme_mode: How the interface is coloured. Match system follows your device's own light or dark setting.
settings_desc.timezone: Your own timezone. Dates and times are shown to you in this zone, whatever zone they were recorded in.
